title: Trinity S³AI Framework: Complete Research Collection v5.2
description:
Trinity S³AI (Sacred Symbolic AI) Framework presents a comprehensive approach to ternary computing with 40+ documented innovations across 7 research domains: (1) Ternary Neural Networks — HSLM-1.95M achieves PPL 125.3 on TinyStories with 20× memory compression; (2) Zero-DSP FPGA — Pure LUT-based inference requiring 0 DSP blocks with 37.8% LUT reduction; (3) TRI-27 ISA — 27-register balanced ternary instruction set with Coptic 3-bank encoding; (4) Queen Lotus Cycle — 6-phase autonomous orchestration with Jaccard similarity retrieval; (5) Tri Language — Linear types, algebraic effects, dual-target codegen to Zig/Verilog; (6) Sacred GF16/TF3 — φ-optimal number formats with 98.4% information retention; (7) VSA Operations — HybridBigInt SIMD achieving 17.2× speedup. All implementations are pure Zig 0.15.x with zero external dependencies, complete reproducibility artifacts, and MLSys reproducibility cards.

This parent collection includes 7 component bundles:
- B001: Ternary Neural Networks (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19227733)
- B002: Zero-DSP FPGA (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19227735)
- B003: TRI-27 ISA (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19227737)
- B004: Queen Lotus Cycle (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19227739)
- B005: Tri Language (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19227741)
- B006: Sacred GF16/TF3 (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19227743)
- B007: VSA Operations (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19227745)
references: Ma et al., The Era of 1-bit LLMs, arXiv:2402.17764 (2024)
